svg.title: One tissue, three explanatory scales
svg.desc: A tissue section, a columnar cell symbol and a membrane-junction detail are displayed at different illustrative scales. The first zoom begins in the epithelial sheet and selects a columnar cell. The second selects the upper lateral interface and shows a generic junction between membranes. No magnification value is claimed.

text.tspan: Zoom connectors indicate correspondence, not biological causation
Schematic at unequal, uncalibrated scales. Dashed connectors mean a change of scale, not transport or causation. Junction
detail is symbolic, not a molecular reconstruction.
